{guildUserHighestRole} - Gives the user's highest role in the guild.
{serverName} - Gives the server's name.
{serverId} - Gives the server's ID.
{serverAvatar} - Gives the server's avatar URL.
{memberCount} - Gives the total number of members in the server.
{serverOwner} - Gives the server owner's username.
{serverOwnerId} - Gives the server owner's ID.
{serverCreationDate} - Gives the server's creation date.
{serverRegion} - Gives the server's region.
{serverDescription} - Gives the server's description.
{serverBoostCount} - Gives the number of server boosts.
{serverBoostLevel} - Gives the server's boost level.
